templates.description: Unsettling, close-miked dread built from low-string extended techniques, dark low woodwinds, prepared piano and granular atmosphere. Leaves room for silence and sparse, shocking hits.
templates.treatment: Clusters and aleatoric swells in the strings; sul ponticello and tremolo low strings; glissandi, col legno and harmonics; bass clarinet multiphonics and key clicks; sparse low hits rather than constant impacts.

templates.description: A stripped-back psychological horror palette for close, claustrophobic scenes: one solo cello and bass, bass clarinet, prepared piano and a single drone. Ideal when silence does most of the work.
templates.treatment: Solo sul ponticello and harmonics, breath and key-click noises, isolated prepared-piano strikes over a barely moving drone.

templates.description: Gothic, cathedral-scale dread: pipe organ, choir and low brass over a full string section, coloured by celesta and tubular bells. Built for hauntings, crypts and the uncanny.
templates.treatment: Pedal points in organ and basses, divisi string clusters and tremolo, ominous low-brass and choir unisons, bell tolls and tam-tam swells.

templates.description: Slow-burning tension from muted low strings, repeating viola and cello cells, a low pulse and ticking percussion. Designed to build steadily toward a reveal.
templates.treatment: Sul tasto and con sordino sustains, measured tremolo, short repeating ostinato cells in violas/celli, long crescendos into hard cuts.

templates.description: A modern hybrid take on tension: string ostinati locked to synth pulses, sub bass and processed percussion. Suited to contemporary thriller and procedural cues.
templates.treatment: Measured tremolo and spiccato cells locked to a sidechained synth pulse; filter sweeps and risers into hits; sub drops at section changes.

templates.description: Relentless chase energy: short strings and syncopated ostinati over low brass stabs, synth bass, taiko and metallic impacts. Built to drive picture forward.
templates.treatment: Spiccato and marcato strings in syncopated ostinati, low-brass stabs on accents, taiko patterns with metallic hits marking cuts.

templates.description: Curious, understated chamber colours for clues and puzzles: piano, clarinet, vibraphone, harp, muted trumpet and chamber strings. Plenty of air between motifs.
templates.treatment: Sparse motifs passed between instruments, pizzicato strings, soft-mallet vibraphone, suspended (unresolved) harmony and harmon-muted trumpet colour.

templates.description: Light, bouncy comedy built on pizzicato strings, chattering oboe, bassoon and clarinet, xylophone and piano. Great for awkward moments and gentle mischief.
templates.treatment: Pizzicato and staccato throughout, grace notes and short scalar runs in the woodwinds, xylophone doubling punchlines.

templates.description: Broad, physical comedy for pratfalls and chases: bassoon, trombone, clarinet and tuba with woodblock and xylophone punctuation. Exaggerated, fast and cartoonish.
templates.treatment: Trombone and clarinet glissandi, brass falls, heavy accents, rapid chromatic runs; woodblock and cymbal chokes land the gags.

templates.description: Sparkling, light-footed fantasy: flute and piccolo flutters over celesta, harp, pizzicato strings and glockenspiel. A storybook palette for wonder and mischief.
templates.treatment: Trills and flutter-tongue in the flutes, harp and celesta arpeggios, light staccato pizzicato, glockenspiel sparkles on phrase ends.

templates.description: Warm, lyrical romance led by solo violin and cello over legato strings, piano, harp and warm woodwinds. Supports both tender intimacy and a full-hearted swell.
templates.treatment: Long legato lines, portamento used sparingly in solos, lyrical suspensions resolving late, piano and harp arpeggios underneath.

templates.description: An intimate romance setting: string quartet with piano and optional harp. Suits period pieces, quiet confessions and small-scale love themes.
templates.treatment: Close-voiced legato quartet writing, tasteful portamento in the first violin, piano carrying broken-chord support.

templates.description: Raw, quiet grief carried by a solo cello and felt piano, with soft muted strings and English horn. Restraint is the point: few notes, held long.
templates.treatment: Long sustains with expressive swells, sparse voicings with open spacing, con sordino strings, English horn answering phrases.

templates.description: Gentle melancholy for reflection and memory: piano with solo strings, clarinet and a soft ambient pad. Motifs are restrained and leave wide rests.
templates.treatment: Soft legato, restrained motifs, wide rests between phrases, pad and sustained strings holding the harmonic floor.

templates.description: A minimal, intimate sadness: felt piano, one solo cello, a soft pad and a faint texture layer. For quiet aftermaths and voice-over.
templates.treatment: Single-line felt-piano motifs with pedal, a cello answering sparingly, long pad tails and plenty of silence.

templates.description: An inspirational build from solo piano to full strings and horns, glued by a warm synth pad. Made for turning points, reunions and resolve.
templates.treatment: Gradual layering from piano alone, legato string build with broadening voicings, horns entering for the final lift.

templates.description: Contemporary uplift with a pulsing synth and light processed percussion under piano, strings and horns. Fits tech, sport and documentary montages.
templates.treatment: Eighth-note synth pulse from the start, string ostinato joining, legato horns and a percussion build into the final chorus.

templates.description: Classic heroic orchestra: horns, trumpets and trombones over soaring full strings with timpani and cymbals. For victories, arrivals and noble resolve.
templates.treatment: Marcato brass statements and fanfares, soaring legato violins, rhythmic low-string ostinati, timpani rolls into cymbal crashes.

templates.description: The full-scale heroic palette with doubled brass, tuba, choir, harp and complete percussion section. For finales and big-screen victories.
templates.treatment: Fanfares across horns and trumpets, tuba-anchored brass chorales, choir on climaxes, sweeping string runs and snare-driven ostinati.

templates.description: Maximum scale: full orchestra, choir, percussion ensemble and supporting synth layers. Built for sweeping vistas, battles and trailer-sized climaxes.
templates.treatment: Divisi strings, driving string and brass ostinati, brass fanfares, choir on sustained climaxes, layered percussion builds into downbeats.

templates.description: Trailer-style hybrid epic: combined string and brass sections fused with distorted bass, processed percussion, impacts and risers, crowned by choir.
templates.treatment: Ostinato strings locked to synth pulses, brass stabs and braams, riser-into-impact builds, sub drops at hits.

templates.description: Fast, aggressive combat scoring: short strings and brass over low winds, drums and pulse synths. Odd-meter options keep fights unpredictable.
templates.treatment: Spiccato and staccatissimo ostinati, hard accents, brass stabs and rips, low-wind doublings of the bass line, fast drum patterns.

templates.description: An all-acoustic action orchestra with no synths: full strings, doubled brass, low winds and orchestral percussion. For period battles and classic adventure fights.
templates.treatment: Spiccato ostinati, brass stabs and rips, xylophone doubling string figures, bass drum and timpani hits on accents.

templates.description: Bright, sweeping adventure orchestra: full strings, horns, flutes and woodwinds with harp and percussion. For journeys, vistas and the thrill of discovery.
templates.treatment: Broad horn themes, arpeggiated woodwind and harp figures, sweeping string runs, timpani and triangle punctuation.

templates.description: Enchanted orchestral colour: celesta, harp, wordless choir and flutes over shimmering strings and tuned percussion. For spells, hidden worlds and wonder.
templates.treatment: String harmonics and tremolo shimmer, harp glissandi, celesta and glockenspiel sparkle, choir on soft vowels, alto flute colour.

templates.description: Modern magical palette where celesta, harp and choir blend with shimmering synth arpeggios and processed strings. Suits contemporary fantasy and animation.
templates.treatment: Arpeggiated synth sparkle doubling harp and celesta, evolving pads under choir, reversed textures into reveals.

templates.description: Spacious sci-fi exploration from analog-style synths, hybrid strings, evolving pads and processed percussion. For vast spaces, discovery and technology.
templates.treatment: Slow filter motion on pads and polysynths, arpeggiated pulses, evolving drones, hybrid strings swelling under synth lines.

templates.description: A lean analog-synth palette for lonely space and quiet technology: one polysynth, an arpeggiator, a drone and sub bass.
templates.treatment: Slowly opening filters, a single repeating arpeggio, long drones and very sparse melodic events.

templates.description: Oppressive, mechanised sci-fi: distorted synth bass, metal percussion, processed strings and noise layers. For surveillance states, machines and ruined futures.
templates.treatment: Gated pulses, interlocking polyrhythms across percussion layers, dissonant pads, saturation and noise bursts as transitions.

templates.description: Solemn military drama: field snare, low brass and strings with timpani and a solo trumpet. For sacrifice, remembrance and the cost of conflict.
templates.treatment: Measured snare rolls, restrained ostinati in the low strings, brass chorale writing, a solo trumpet line over sustained strings.

templates.description: A modest period ensemble (strings, viola da gamba, harpsichord, lute and recorder) with an optional modern cinematic string-and-pad layer. Era-specific palettes (Renaissance, Baroque, Classical and later) live in the era pack; swap or merge one in to match the setting.
templates.treatment: Period-dependent ornaments and articulations: trills, mordents and continuo realisation for Baroque settings, non-vibrato strings, light detaché. The optional cinematic layer adds legato sustain beneath.

templates.description: Transparent, unobtrusive scoring for real lives and voice-over: piano, chamber strings, acoustic guitar, soft pads and restrained percussion.
templates.treatment: Minimal repeating motifs, transparent textures that leave space for dialogue, gentle pulse from guitar and mallets.

templates.description: Open, flowing pastoral colours: flute, oboe and clarinet with harp, acoustic guitar and strings. For landscapes, wildlife and calm mornings.
templates.treatment: Legato woodwind lines over open fifths and fourths, flowing harp and guitar arpeggios, warm string sustains.

templates.description: Smoky late-night noir: muted trumpet and tenor sax over upright bass, brushed drums and piano, with an optional dark string bed.
templates.treatment: Falls and soft vibrato in the horns, minor-key jazz voicings with extensions, brushes and walking bass, harmon-muted trumpet colour.

templates.description: Wide-open frontier sound: strummed acoustic guitar, harmonica, fiddle and whistling over low strings and drums, with tremolo electric guitar for standoffs.
templates.treatment: Strummed and tremolo-picked guitars, open-string drones in fiddle and low strings, lonesome whistle and harmonica melodies.

templates.description: Stadium-sized sports energy: drumline, horns and trumpets with driving strings, electric bass and synth accents. For wins, highlights and team intros.
templates.treatment: Rhythmic unison hits, brass fanfares, punchy synth stabs on accents, string ostinati driving the groove.

templates.description: Calm, slowly breathing ambience: soft pads, felt piano, soft mallets and sustained strings over a gentle drone. For meditation, rest and stillness.
templates.treatment: Slow attacks and long releases, sparse piano phrases, mallets with soft sticks, drones held for entire sections.
